No, you don't need 20% down to buy in Ontario. Under current federal rules, the minimum down payment is 5% on the first $500,000 of the price and 10% on the portion from $500,000 to $1.5 million. At $1.5 million or more, the minimum is 20%. With less than 20% down, mortgage default insurance applies. Example: a $750,000 home needs a minimum of $50,000 down.
